sections.title: A softer version of kell
sections.content: You already know kell ("is needed / must") from A1. kellene is its softer cousin — "should, ought to" — and works exactly the same way, on its own or with a bare infinitive: Kellene többet pihenni ("One should rest more"). It states good advice rather than a strict requirement.

items.english: You/one shouldn't eat so much sugar.
It would also be good to do sports.

sections.content: kell states a fact ("it's needed"), kellene offers an opinion ("it would be good") — the difference between Kell pihenni ("rest is needed") and Kellene pihenni ("you should really rest") is all in that one extra syllable.
